intro: Following the systematic elimination of their local chieftains in the Barrens, the Kolkar centaur mount a desperate retaliation out of Desolace. An invading force marches directly upon Regthar Deathgate's outpost west of the Crossroads, culminating in a fierce confrontation with Warlord Krom'zar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened. I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance. My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!
Face the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens. Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears. Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done it! You have defeated the Kolkar!
I will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, friend.
Stand tall. You do yourself, and the Horde, proud.
